images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a newly drawn idle-pose character sprite candidate for the original 2D side-view platform fighter あにあにバトル！！.
Input images: Image 1 is the character's official design and must determine identity and costume. Image 2 is the user's pixel-art comparison screenshot; use ONLY the crisp visible pixel clusters, outlined silhouettes and restrained 3-tone shading of the right-hand sprite as a rendering-quality reference. Do not copy the knight, sword, clothing, pose, typography, phone UI or social media graphics.
Primary request: draw exactly ONE complete character in a calm combat-ready standing idle pose, facing RIGHT in side/three-quarter view. Both feet resting on one baseline, knees gently bent, natural arms, clean readable silhouette, head and shoes fully visible with generous transparent margins.
Style: authentic meticulously placed game pixel art, constructed on a consistent low-resolution square pixel grid, approximately 96 logical pixels high for the figure, then enlarged using a crisp nearest-neighbor appearance. Visible evenly sized pixel steps, deliberate clusters, dark single-pixel outlines, approximately 24-32 deliberately chosen colors, limited three-tone shading per material. Charming compact proportions about 4 heads tall, not realistic anime proportions. Clean facial features readable at small size. No painterly shading, gradients, blur, antialiasing, noisy dithering, 3D render, jagged inconsistent pixel sizes, color-fringe halos, transparent checkerboard baked into image, scenery, shadows on floor, glow, speech marks, text, logos, weapons or extra character copies.
Composition: one sprite centered on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. This is one STILL idle key pose, not an animation strip or a character sheet.
Subject: Toma, young Japanese male with tousled BLACK hair, visibly bright BLUE eyes that remain clear beneath bangs, a black/charcoal business suit, white collared shirt, very dark blue-violet tie, black trousers and black leather shoes. Preserve the black rectangular handheld device from his official design, held down close alongside his hip in one hand. Serious composed expression. Upright relaxed prepared stance, free hand slightly raised, no exaggerated punching. Separate charcoal lapel/arm/torso shapes with restrained lighter gray clusters so the black suit is legible. No armor, scarf, sword, white hair or added sci-fi suit.
